en.headline: CUHK study finds electroacupuncture eases tinnitus in middle-aged adults
en.dek: A trial of 90 patients aged 50 to 70, commissioned by Pok Oi Hospital, reported lower loudness scores and more than half moving from moderate to mild after five weeks of treatment.
body: Researchers at the Chinese University of Hong Kong’s School of Chinese Medicine have reported that electroacupuncture, alone or combined with warm needling, significantly reduced tinnitus loudness and daily bother in middle-aged and older adults.

The study, commissioned by Pok Oi Hospital and published in an international journal, recruited 90 patients aged 50 to 70 between December 2022 and April 2024. Participants had suffered tinnitus for periods ranging from half a month to 24 months. They were divided into three groups: one receiving electroacupuncture, one receiving electroacupuncture plus warm needling, and a control group that received no acupuncture during the trial.

After five weeks of treatment (ten sessions), the two acupuncture groups showed loudness score drops of about 1.91 and 1.81 points compared with the control group. More than half the patients in both acupuncture arms moved from moderate to mild tinnitus. The researchers said the approach has clinical practicality and safety and could serve as a supplementary option for this age group.

The control group’s scores worsened over the ten-week observation period. The team suggested the treatment may help regulate cochlear blood flow and neural activity, as well as autonomic balance and auditory central plasticity.

zh.headline: 中大研究：電針可減輕中老年耳鳴困擾
zh.dek: 博愛醫院委託中大中醫學院進行的研究招募90名50至70歲患者，五周療程後耳鳴響度評分下降，逾半由中度改善至輕度。
body: 香港中文大學中醫學院研究團隊表示，電針治療，或配合溫針，能明顯降低50至70歲患者的耳鳴響度，並紓緩日常生活困擾。
這項由博愛醫院委託的研究已於國際學術期刊發表。團隊在2022年12月至2024年4月招募90名50至70歲、受耳鳴困擾半個月至24個月的患者，分成三組：電針組、電針結合溫針組，以及不接受針灸的對照組。
五周、共十次治療後，兩個針灸組的耳鳴響度評分較對照組分別下降約1.91及1.81分，逾半參加者由「中度」轉為「輕度」。研究人員認為這種模式具臨床實用性及安全性，可作為中老年耳鳴患者的補充治療選擇。
對照組在十周觀察期內評分惡化。團隊指針灸或有助調節耳蝸血流及核活性，並透過自主神經平衡與聽覺中樞神經系統可塑性減輕症狀。
